purpose: Trigger an explicit application action with intent, loading, and disabled semantics.
accessibility: Expose a stable accessible name and use the semantic element for the interaction.
Preserve visible focus, keyboard reachability, and disabled or pending state semantics.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: wrap
api.description: Opt into natural CTA wrapping. Ordinary actions use a bounded single-line label with ellipsis; the full accessible name remains available.

api.name: leadingIcon
api.description: Semantic icon rendered before the label.

api.name: trailingIcon
api.description: Semantic icon rendered after the label.

api.name: loading
api.description: Communicates pending work and prevents duplicate activation.

api.name: disabled
api.description: Prevents interaction while preserving the disabled state.
